comments.author: @henrysing2782
comments.text:
First of all thanks for your video view about my city. I am a local (currently living in Finland) and I am very beyond disatisfied about the video you make. There are few things I want to correct you in the video. 

1. The pollution you showed in the video, it was not true. It is foggy. Usually in the stormy day or even in the early morning, it can look like that but definitely not pollution. Da Nang is no way having pollution like that, compared to Beijing China, Beijing can look polluted like that but Da Nang will never be. Da Nang is surrounded by nature with jungle and sea/beach, that will not make it cloudly polluted like that. 

2. The sim card, I am sorry it happened everywhere, even in Europe. When you purchase something, better you know the service and you better ask local or get the review. Danang people are very honest and friendly but of course, there are some places they want to sell stuffs and trick customers of course, it happens everywhere in the world. To make sim card or internet, you can simply go to mobiphone or viettel stores to purchase it (same as Elisa or DNA in Finland). 

3. People cough and in our culture, it is allowed to cough and show it. We do not judge or look bad on them. 

Da Nang is no way perfect but it is a very enjoyable city with life-convenient-service that you will definitely not have it anywhere else. People are friendly and helpful, nature is all around and cost of living is affordable. AND definitely air quality will not be a problem to people, it is a generally a clean city. 

AND remember that, Vietnam has over 90 million people and do not compare it to small populated nations, of course it is more difficult to manage such a huge population and people are diversed. I hope you get my point. 

There are negative things about Da Nang ofc like any other cities in the world, but I hope the negative is really a negative, the difference is acceptable. Culture is different and custom is different too. I hope you respect my country and our custom. Thanks kiitos
